units.source_text: 本因坊名人生于明治七年，两三天前刚过六十五寿辰。

en.t: The Honinbo Meijin was born in the seventh year of Meiji, and two or three days earlier he had just passed his sixty-fifth birthday.

units.source_text: 鉴于日华事变 [1] 后的时局，只好在家中庆祝了。

en.t: Given the state of affairs after the Sino-Japanese Incident [1], there was nothing for it but to celebrate at home.

units.source_text: 翌日续弈之前，名人说：“红叶馆的建成，同我的生日，究竟谁在先呢？”

en.t: The next day, before play resumed, the Meijin said, "Which came first, I wonder, the completion of the Koyokan or my birthday?"

units.source_text: 他还谈到明治年代的村濑秀甫八段和本因坊秀荣名人也都在这栋房里下过棋。

en.t: He also mentioned that in the Meiji era Murase Shuho, eighth dan, and Honinbo Shuei Meijin had both played go in this building.
